description: On the tabletop in front of you are a white paper cup with a toothbrush inside it and a small toothpaste tube lying nearby. The right hand reaches into the cup to take out the toothbrush, while the left hand picks up the toothpaste tube; then the left hand brings the tube over the toothbrush head and squeezes toothpaste onto the bristles as the right hand holds the toothbrush steady, before lowering the items back toward the table.
